messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: migration `add_user_feature_flag_idx` (run id db-mig-20260320-42). Target: prod-us-east-1. Canary=5% -> holdpoint after step `apply-index`. Triggered by @kevin.
kevin: Heads-up: this will add an index on users(feature_flag) + a backfill of ~12M rows. Backfill runs as a throttled job. Plan: canary tenant=internal 5% for 30m observation. No other schema deploys during window.
maria: Lock behavior? does this take any exclusive locks?
kevin: Using `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY` for the index. Backfill performs chunked updates; there is a brief DDL metadata lock when commit finishes but no table rewrite. DB team verified as safe for online traffic.
paul: Set a holdpoint after `apply-index`. If write p50 latency on user-service >200ms for 5m, we rollback. I've added smoke monitors on release board and a Pager threshold.
eng-release: Can we pin the app version for canary to 1.13.2 to avoid unrelated client changes? @maria please confirm.
maria: Ack. Will pin canary deploy group to 1.13.2.
kevin: Also adding a feature-flag gate: `new_feature_index`. If flag evaluation is fail-open for external tenants we must abort. Preflight will check flags.
maria: Added preflight script: `./scripts/check-flag-assignments.sh` — it exits 1 if any external tenant has `new_feature_index`=on. Will be run by deploybot before canary advance.
deploy-bot: Holdpoint reached at step `apply-index`. Waiting for manual `deploy-bot continue` from @kevin or `deploy-bot rollback`.
kevin: Running quick smoke: user-create load 100rps for 2m. p95 write latency 180ms, errors 0, K/V q depth stable. Ok to continue. :thumbsup:
paul: Noted a small Redis master KV cache bump for ~2m during the first minute of backfill. Watching. Escape hatch: if Q depth >500 or retries spike we stop ramp.
deploy-bot: Canary ramp to 25% initiated. Backfill ramping to rate=2000 rows/min.
maria: Alert: backfill job retry count increased (errors from remote shard) at T+45m. Investigating. Pause ramp?
kevin: Pause ramp. Drop canary back to 5% and throttle backfill to 500 rows/min. Do not rollback the index at this time.
maria: Done — canary reduced to 5%, backfill rate set to 500 rows/min. Re-running health checks.
kevin: Added release note: "Reduced backfill rate after transient spike in retries; monitoring for 20m."
paul: If retries don't trend down in 60m, recommend `deploy-bot rollback` and notify customers on status page. Also prepare app pin rollback playbook.
maria: Noted — will open a short post-deploy incident if we hit the 60m threshold. Tagging @eng-release for postmortem.
deploy-bot: No rollback executed. Manual continue allowed. Will auto-fail the rollout if critical thresholds are met.
